results.trade_name: VIEWPOINT(TM) CK SYSTEM
results.ao_statement: APPROVAL FOR THE REFRACTEC VIEWPOINT CK SYSTEM.  THIS DEVICE IS INDICATED FOR:  TEMPORARY REDUCTION OF SPHERICAL HYPEROPIA IN PATIENTS WHO HAVE 0.75 D TO 3.25 D OF CYCLOPLEGIC SPHERICAL HYPEROPIA, LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO 0.75 D OF REFRACTIVE ASTIGMATISM (MINUS CYLINDER FORMAT), A CYCLOPLEGIC SPHERICAL EQUIVALENT OF 0.75 D TO 3.00 D, AND ARE 40 YEARS OF AGE OR GREATER WITH A DOCUMENTED STABILITY OF REFRACTION FOR THE PRIOR 12 MONTH, AS DEMONSTRATED BY A CHANGE OF LESS THAN 0.50 D IN SPHERICAL AND CYLINDRICAL COMPONENTS OF THE MANIFEST REFRACTION.  THE MAGNITUDE OF CORRECTION WITH THIS TREATMENT DIMINISHES OVER TIME, WITH SOME PATIENTS RETAINING SOME OR ALL OF THEIR INTENDED REFRACTIVE CORRECTION.
